class S2D4P.train.dataloader.BatchData(input: Tensor, target: Tensor, added_features: Tensor | None = None, metadata: list[dict] | None = None, return_spatial_mask: bool = False, share_spatial_mask: bool = True)

Bases: BatchDataABC

Container for a batch of training data.

Input and target NaN values are replaced with zeros after optional spatial validity masks are constructed.

Parameters:

  • input (torch.Tensor) – Batched model input tensor.

  • target (torch.Tensor) – Batched target tensor.

  • added_features (torch.Tensor | None) – Optional additional features associated with the batch.

  • metadata (list[dict] | None) – Optional per-sample metadata.

  • return_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether validity masks are constructed from non-NaN input and target values.

  • share_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether validity masks are reduced across the batch dimension and shared between batch instances.

class S2D4P.train.dataloader.TrainDataloaderConfig(dataset: TrainDatasetConfig, batch_size: int, time_features: list | None = None, train_years_slice: tuple | list | None = None, num_validation_years: int = 0, num_data_workers: int = 0, prefetch_factor: int = 2, drop_last: bool = False, load: bool = False, share_spatial_mask: bool = False)

Bases: DataloaderConfigABC

Configuration for training and validation data loaders.

Defines batching, temporal feature generation, train-validation temporal splitting, worker settings, spatial-mask behavior, and distributed data loading.

Parameters:

  • dataset (TrainDatasetConfig) – Configuration used to construct training and validation datasets.

  • batch_size (int) – Number of samples in each batch.

  • time_features (list | None) – Temporal features added to each dataset sample.

  • train_years_slice (tuple | list | None) – Optional start and stop years restricting the data used for training and validation.

  • num_validation_years (int) – Number of final years in the selected period reserved for validation.

  • num_data_workers (int) – Number of worker processes used for data loading.

  • prefetch_factor (int | None) – Number of batches prefetched by each data-loading worker.

  • drop_last (bool) – Whether the final incomplete batch is discarded.

  • load (bool) – Whether underlying xarray datasets are loaded into memory when opened.

  • share_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether spatial validity masks are reduced across the batch dimension and shared between batches.

build_train_loader(return_metadata: bool = False, return_spatial_mask: bool = False, shuffle: bool | None = None)

Build the training data loader.

A temporal mask prevents samples whose target times extend beyond the common data coverage. The resulting dataset is constructed from the selected training times and configured temporal features.

Parameters:

  • return_metadata (bool) – Whether samples include their sampling-coordinate metadata.

  • return_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether batches contain spatial validity masks.

  • shuffle (bool | None) – Whether training samples are shuffled. If None, the data loader selects the appropriate default.

Returns:

Configured training data loader.

Return type:

Dataloader

Raises:

RuntimeError – If distributed data-loader setup has not been completed.

build_validation_loader(return_metadata: bool = False, return_spatial_mask: bool = False, shuffle: bool | None = None, supress_error: bool = True)

Build the validation data loader.

Validation samples are restricted to the configured validation years and masked when their target times extend beyond the common data coverage.

Parameters:

  • return_metadata (bool) – Whether samples include their sampling-coordinate metadata.

  • return_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether batches contain spatial validity masks.

  • shuffle (bool | None) – Whether validation samples are shuffled.

  • supress_error (bool) – Whether absence of configured validation years produces a warning instead of raising an exception.

Returns:

Configured validation data loader, or None when validation is disabled and supress_error is True.

Return type:

Dataloader | None

Raises:

RuntimeError – If distributed setup has not been completed, or validation is unavailable and supress_error is False.

Warns:

UserWarning – If no validation years are configured and supress_error is True.

setup_distributed(distributed: Distributed, load_path: Path | str | None = None)

Configure training data loading for distributed execution.

The root process fits and saves preprocessing pipelines when necessary. Processes are synchronized before fitted preprocessing state is loaded, and pinned memory is enabled for distributed execution.

Parameters:

  • distributed (Distributed) – Distributed runtime containing rank and world-size information.

  • load_path (Path | str | None) – Directory containing existing fitted preprocessing pipelines. If None, preprocessors are fitted from the configured training data.

S2D4P.train.dataloader.collate_batch(batch, return_spatial_mask: bool = False, share_spatial_mask: bool = False)

Collate training samples into a batch.

Input and target tensors are stacked along the batch dimension together with optional additional features. Per-sample metadata are retained when supplied by the dataset.

Parameters:

  • batch (Any) – Sequence of training samples, optionally paired with per-sample metadata.

  • return_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether input and target validity masks are constructed from missing values.

  • share_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether validity masks are reduced across the batch dimension and shared.

Returns:

Collated training batch containing inputs, targets, optional additional features, metadata, and optional spatial validity masks.

class S2D4P.train.dataset.TrainDataset(config: TrainDatasetConfig, requested_times: Sequence[datetime64 | datetime | datetime] | ndarray | DataArray, time_features: AddedTimeFeatures, mask: DataArray | None = None, return_metadata: bool = False, load: bool = False)

Bases: DatasetABC

Dataset for constructing model inputs and targets during training.

Training samples are assembled from forecast, reference, and conditioning data according to the configured conditioning strategy. When reference data are absent, forecast data are used as reconstruction targets.

Parameters:

  • config (TrainDatasetConfig) – Configuration defining training data sources and sampling behavior.

  • requested_times (Sequence[np.datetime64 | datetime.datetime | cftime.datetime] | np.ndarray | xr.DataArray) – Initialization times requested for training.

  • time_features (AddedTimeFeatures) – Temporal feature generator applied to samples.

  • mask (xr.DataArray | None) – Optional mask identifying sample combinations excluded from training.

  • return_metadata (bool) – Whether each sample is returned with its sampling-coordinate metadata.

  • load (bool) – Whether underlying xarray data are loaded into memory when opened.

class S2D4P.train.dataset.TrainDatasetConfig(forecast: ForecastDataConfig, reference: RefDataConfig | None = None, condition: ConditionDataConfig | None = None, condition_method: str | None = None, lead_times: lead_time_config | None = None)

Bases: DatasetConfigABC

Configuration for a training dataset.

Defines forecast inputs, optional reference targets, optional conditioning data, the conditioning strategy, and forecast lead times used to construct training samples.

Parameters:

  • forecast (ForecastDataConfig) – Forecast data configuration used to construct model inputs and, when no reference data are provided, training targets.

  • reference (RefDataConfig | None) – Optional reference data configuration used to construct training targets.

  • condition (ConditionDataConfig | None) – Optional auxiliary conditioning data configuration.

  • condition_method (str | None) – Method used to associate conditioning data with forecast inputs.

  • lead_times (lead_time_config | None) – Forecast lead times included in training samples. If None, all available input lead times are used.

S2D4P.train.train.main(yaml_config: str) → None

Run the training workflow from a YAML configuration file.

Initializes distributed execution, loads and validates the training configuration, sets a rank-specific random seed, and prepares the experiment directories. Resource monitoring is enabled while the trainer is built, configured for distributed execution, and run. Distributed resources are cleaned up when training completes or an exception is raised.

Parameters:

yaml_config (str) – Path to the YAML file containing the training configuration.

class S2D4P.train.train_configs.TrainConfig(experiment_dir: str, max_epochs: int, train_loader: ~S2D4P.train.dataloader.TrainDataloaderConfig | None, module: ~S2D4P.core.selectors.ModuleSelector | None, losspipeline: ~S2D4P.loss.loss.LosspipelineConfig | None, trainer: ~S2D4P.core.trainer.TrainerConfig | None, optimization: ~S2D4P.core.optimization.OptimizerConfig | None = <factory>, weights: ~S2D4P.data.weights.WeightsConfig | None = <factory>, log_every_n_epochs: int = 5, save_checkpoint: bool = True, seed: int | None = None, resume_dir: str | None = None)

Bases: object

Configuration for a model training experiment.

Coordinates data loading, model construction, loss configuration, optimization, trainer behavior, experiment directories, checkpoint resumption, and reproducibility settings.

Parameters:

  • experiment_dir (str) – Directory in which experiment outputs, checkpoints, logs, figures, and configuration files are stored.

  • max_epochs (int) – Maximum number of training epochs.

  • train_loader (TrainDataloaderConfig | None) – Configuration used to construct training and validation data loaders.

  • module (ModuleSelector | None) – Model module and architecture configuration.

  • losspipeline (LosspipelineConfig | None) – Configuration defining the reconstruction loss pipeline.

  • trainer (TrainerConfig | None) – Configuration controlling the training loop.

  • optimization (OptimizerConfig | None) – Optimizer and learning-rate scheduler configuration.

  • weights (WeightsConfig | None) – Configuration used to construct spatial and variable loss weights.

  • log_every_n_epochs (int) – Number of epochs between metric logging and plot updates.

  • save_checkpoint (bool) – Whether training checkpoints are saved.

  • seed (int | None) – Base random seed used for reproducible training.

  • resume_dir (str | None) – Directory of a halted experiment whose configuration and checkpoint state should be resumed.

prepare_directory(distributed: Distributed, yaml_config: str | None = None)

Prepare experiment directories for training.

For a resumed experiment targeting a new location, the previous experiment directory is copied to the new path. Otherwise, required experiment directories are created. The supplied YAML configuration is copied into the experiment directory by the root process.

Parameters:

  • distributed (Distributed) – Distributed runtime used for root-process detection and synchronization.

  • yaml_config (str | None) – Path to the source training configuration file to copy into the experiment directory.

read_config_from_halted_experiment(resume_dir: str | Path, experiment_dir: str | Path, max_epochs: int) → TrainConfig

Load configuration from a halted training experiment.

The saved configuration is updated with the newly requested experiment directory and maximum epoch count before being reconstructed as a training configuration.

Parameters:

  • resume_dir (str | Path) – Directory containing the halted experiment and its saved configuration.

  • experiment_dir (str | Path) – Experiment directory to use for resumed training.

  • max_epochs (int) – Maximum number of epochs for resumed training.

Returns:

Reconstructed configuration for the resumed experiment.

Return type:

TrainConfig

Raises:

ValueError – If resume_dir does not exist as a directory.

Set the process-specific training random seed.

The configured base seed is offset by process rank so distributed processes use distinct deterministic seeds.

Parameters:

rank (int) – Distributed process rank added to the configured base seed.

S2D4P.train.train_configs.build_trainer(config: TrainConfig, distributed: Distributed, logger: Logger | None = None)

Build the complete training workflow.

Constructs training and validation data loaders, loss weights, the configured model module, reconstruction loss pipeline, optimizer, and trainer. Spatial masks are requested automatically when required by the selected architecture.

Parameters:

  • config (TrainConfig) – Configuration defining the training experiment.

  • distributed (Distributed) – Distributed runtime used for data loading and model device placement.

  • logger (logging.Logger | None) – Logger used for root-process setup messages. If None, messages are printed instead.

Returns:

Fully configured trainer ready for distributed setup and training.

Return type:

Trainer
